headline: Ansar Allah have largely encircled Taiz, cutting supply routes, prices soaring
dek: Ansar Allah strike on Taiz residential area killed two teenage girls Tuesday; UN human rights chief warns besieged Taiz civilians at grave risk, demands aid access and safe civilian exit.
sources: AP (via Times of Israel, bastillepost); UN human rights chief Volker Türk (statement)
fault_line: Is Taiz a Ansar Allah siege crime — or is the humanitarian catastrophe being used as a weapon by all sides?

sections.what_happened: Ansar Allah strike on Taiz residential area killed two teenage girls Tuesday; UN human rights chief warns besieged Taiz civilians at grave risk, demands aid access and safe civilian exit.
sections.what_verified: ToI AP + bastillepost AP carry identical details; Türk statement direct; consistent with earlier reporting of Ansar Allah monthslong Taiz offensive and encirclement.
sections.what_disputed: Saudi envoy Al-Jaber (X): denies siege framing, says Hodeidah port receives food/fuel daily; Ansar Allah side's account of the strike not yet relayed in backbone press.
sections.why_matters: The siege tightens: two girls dead in Taiz while the UN says the city is at grave risk — the human cost behind the missile war.
sections.context: Background: Yemen — NEW (Tuesday, AP via ToI): Ansar Allah strike on residential area in Taiz killed two teenage girls; UN human rights chief Volker Türk: civilians in besieged Taiz at 'grave risk', aid must be allowed in, civilians allowed to leave; Ansar Allah have largely encircled Taiz, cutting supply routes, prices soaring; follows Monday's Shabwa camp strike (73 killed)

totw_analysis: Our read: The siege tightens: two girls dead in Taiz while the UN says the city is at grave risk — the human cost behind the missile war. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is Taiz a Ansar Allah siege crime — or is the humanitarian catastrophe being used as a weapon by all sides?
